include("$ENV{TACTILITY_SDK_PATH}/TactilitySDK.cmake")

# The SDK path in this environment uses backslashes on Windows; CMake include paths
# must use forward slashes.
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "$ENV{TACTILITY_SDK_PATH}" TACTILITY_SDK_INCLUDE_PATH)

file(GLOB_RECURSE SOURCE_FILES Source/*.c Source/*.cpp)

# Generated by the project CMakeLists before this component is configured.
set(BINDINGS_GENERATED_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
set(SOURCE_FILES ${SOURCE_FILES} "${BINDINGS_GENERATED_DIR}/bindings_generated.cpp")

# ESP-IDF links the vendored Lua component through REQUIRES. The POSIX SDK has no
# component dependency graph, so compile the interpreter sources into the module.
if (NOT ESP_PLATFORM)
    file(GLOB LUA_SOURCE_FILES ../components/lua/Source/*.c)
    set(SOURCE_FILES ${SOURCE_FILES} ${LUA_SOURCE_FILES})
    set(LUA_INCLUDE_DIRS ../components/lua/Include ../components/lua/Source)
else ()
    set(LUA_INCLUDE_DIRS "")
endif ()

tactility_component_register(
    SRCS ${SOURCE_FILES}
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        Include
        Private
        Source/lua
        "${BINDINGS_GENERATED_DIR}"
        ${LUA_INCLUDE_DIRS}
        # The POSIX SDK's component helper does not propagate REQUIRES include paths,
        # so add the module header directory explicitly. It exists on every platform.
        "${TACTILITY_SDK_INCLUDE_PATH}/Modules/cjson-module/include"
    REQUIRES lua notification-module cjson-module
)
